summary: Deliver an evidence-backed comparison that preserves incomparable or missing data.
instructions: Include disposition, decision context, alternatives, criteria/weights and their source, a comparison matrix, evidence references, sensitivity/assumptions, contrary evidence, review, and remaining questions.
Each matrix entry identifies the source/location, comparable conditions, and uncertainty; use unknown rather than a fabricated score when data is unavailable.
Rank only when the criteria/weights and evidence justify it. Otherwise explain the unranked tradeoffs and the next decision-relevant evidence needed.
